harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the requested SSH public key and enforced key-based SSH authentication (password/keyboard-interactive auth disabled, password locked). Verified via a live SSH auth attempt that password auth is rejected, both before and after a full node restart, and confirmed the node's boot identity changed to prove a real reboot occurred with state persisting.
actions_performed: Checked baseline: opsadmin did not exist; sshd active; only ChallengeResponseAuthentication no was pre-set
Created opsadmin user (useradd -m -s /bin/bash)
Installed ~/.ssh (0700) and authorized_keys (0600) with the given ed25519 key, owned by opsadmin
Locked opsadmin's password (passwd -l)
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf enforcing PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
Validated sshd config (sshd -t) and confirmed no earlier directive in sshd_config overrides the drop-in (only commented-out lines after the Include)
Restarted sshd and confirmed via sshd -T that key-only settings are active
Verified live: password-auth SSH attempt to opsadmin@node1 is rejected with only publickey/gssapi offered

Captured baseline boot_id and service state, triggered a safe systemctl reboot (backgrounded so the ack returned), polled until reconnect, and confirmed boot_id changed (4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4 -> d0bad5ab-aecb-49b4-a936-3b2466695c1b)
Post-restart verified sshd active, key-only settings intact, opsadmin account/key/lock state intact, and password auth still rejected

evidence.requirement: opsadmin created with the specified SSH public key installed
evidence.summary: Baseline showed no opsadmin user; user was created and authorized_keys populated with exactly the requested ed25519 key, owned and permissioned correctly (.ssh 700, authorized_keys 600).

evidence.requirement: Key-based SSH authentication required (password auth disabled)
evidence.summary: Added sshd drop-in disabling password/kbd-interactive auth, validated syntax, confirmed via sshd -T the effective config, confirmed no conflicting earlier directive, restarted sshd, and proved live via a rejected password-auth SSH attempt (publickey/gssapi only offered); opsadmin's shadow entry shows locked password (!).
Captured pre-restart boot_id (4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4), uptime, and sshd active status as baseline.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart protocol: restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnect; polled through the outage (connection timeouts/reset) until reconnect; boot_id changed to d0bad5ab-aecb-49b4-a936-3b2466695c1b, proving an actual reboot occurred.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart protocol: post-restart recovery verification
evidence.summary: After reconnect, confirmed sshd active with key-only auth settings intact, opsadmin user/key/locked-password state intact, and a live SSH password-auth attempt still rejected (publickey/gssapi only).
